title: Signal: Conda channel TLS verification disabled
scope: A .condarc file that declares an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
limitations: It matches an `ssl_verify` switch set to false in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .condarc that mentions an `ssl_verify` switch set to false in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
